lines.3: 「Hm! Everyone is present. Excellent. In any age, the body remains one's greatest asset.」
lines.4: 「Now I shall return your recent tests! Each of you will receive your paper with the vigor of a soldier striking down an enemy on the battlefield!」
lines.5: Once a week, we had a class taught by the headmaster himself.
lines.6: It was our school's unique curriculum for studying the 'heart.'
lines.7: 「This is the one subject I score well in.」
lines.8: Fukahire was the kind of idiot who crossed out the ordinary character for 'male' in the sex box and replaced it with the macho character meaning 'man among men.'
lines.9: But doing that earned him five bonus points from the headmaster.
lines.10: Was that really how this class worked?
lines.14: Question 2: Which do you save, one hundred lives or one life?
lines.16: 「I wrote one hundred for now, and he marked it correct.」
lines.17: 「It depends on my mood, but naturally I would save both. I can be rather greedy.」
lines.18: 「One person or a hundred? If the hundred were strangers and the one was my friend, I'd save the one.」
lines.19: 「I'd save the beautiful women. The rest can survive on their own.」
lines.20: 「Hmm... I wrote that I didn't know, and he marked it wrong. I couldn't tell which answer was right...」
lines.22: 「While you are young, try all manner of things. Romance, travel, sports, study--anything will do.」
lines.23: 「One day, those experiences will become your 'strength.' For example, daily training has made me capable of defeating as many as nine bears bare-handed.」
lines.25: 「If any of you find your days dull, every day the same, and crave some excitement, come to me.」
lines.26: 「I will train you in many ways and look after you.」
